description: One page of the Following home feed, reached by clicking the Following tab on x.com/home. Observed as a POST with variables and features in the JSON body.
observation_recipe: open https://x.com/home and click the Following tab
repeat in a fresh run and compare variables
scroll to record a continuation cursor
re-observe after a rejected query id
verification_cases: identity: tweet ids match the browser response
attribution: author id and handle come from core.user_results
links: expanded URL entities are preserved
continuation: page two uses the Bottom cursor from page one
auth failure: 401 or 403 stops the run
unknown shape: post-bearing modules fail the page
